items.title: Feeling Angry
parts: Your face may feel hot, and your hands may want to squeeze.
You can take three slow breaths and squeeze a soft pillow.
You can always talk to a grown-up you trust about how you feel.

items.title: Saying Thank You
parts: Saying thank you is a kind thing to do.
It makes the other person feel happy and seen.
Today, say thank you to someone who helps you.
You can always talk to a grown-up you trust about kind ideas too.
